meta.name: PR Review
meta.description: Review a dazl-pr-panel-sandbox pull request for correctness, tests and style, run its checks, and summarize the findings. Read-only.

nodes.title: Start with a pull request
nodes.description: Name the pull request number or URL. Without one, the checked-out branch is reviewed against origin/main.

nodes.title: Review the pull request
nodes.description: Correctness, tests and style, plus npm test and npm run build on the PR head.
nodes.prompt: Review the pull request named in the request. Done when: every changed file was read, npm test and npm run build were run on the PR head (or the reason they could not be is stated), and the output holds a verdict, findings by severity with file:line and a fix for each, and the check results.
